verdict.rationale: ClickHouse offers background-running automations in the data-layer sense — Incremental Materialized Views execute automatically on every insert, shifting computation off query time, and asynchronous/bulk insert strategies run without blocking the caller — but there is no evidence of an AI-agent-specific automation/scheduling layer (e.g., a scheduled agent job runner, cron-like agentic workflow trigger) that ties this to autonomous AI behavior beyond MCP query access. missing for 10: a documented mechanism for scheduling/running AI-agent-driven automations autonomously (not just data pipeline triggers), independent hands-on confirmation of any such agentic scheduler.
